Built the "instant lane" alternative to v0/Lovable — upload a PDF, get flashcards. Type an idea, get a UI. No setup.
Been frustrated that every AI UI builder requires project setup, onboarding, credit systems — all before you see anything.

Built Kreo to fix that. The whole point is zero friction:

— type an idea → live interactive UI artifact

— upload a PDF or image → flashcards, study guide, quiz, whatever makes sense

— no project, no workspace, no setup

Built the first version in 2 hours. $1/month.

 

Genuinely curious — what's the thing you'd want to instantly visualise that current tools make you jump through hoops for?
